## Working of Recursion

![Working of recursion in Python](data:image/png;base64,)

As we can see,

- The recursive calls are made first
- Once n becomes 0, the functions start returning values

| Function | Value of n | Return value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1st function | 3 + calculate_sum(2) |  |
| 2nd function | 3 + calculate_sum(2) + calculate_sum(1) |  |
| 3rd function | 3 + calculate_sum(2) + calcualte_sum(1) + calculate_sum(0) |  |
| 4th function | 3 + calculate_sum(2) + calcualte_sum(1) + 0 | 4th function returns 0 |
| 3rd function | 3 + calculate_sum(2) + 1 | 3rd function returns 0 + 1 = 1 |
| 2nd function | 3 + 3 | 2nd function returns 1 + 2 = 3 |
| 1st function | 6 | returns 6 |
